accepted_boundary.delivery_rule: Deliver the least-divergent valid artifact, preserve the source and disclose target-specific fidelity loss instead of rejecting solely for that loss.
b1: DOC and RTF may have minor render or line reflow while preserving 13 pages and exact extracted text.
ODT may expand the 13-page source to 14 pages; all three projects share the same result.
n1: DOC may change field and inline-object identities while retaining nine original revisions and one comment.
RTF may change field and inline-object identities; current preserves the source seven-page layout and nine original revisions.
ODT may reduce paragraphs, tables, fields, revisions and sections exactly as recorded by the frozen projection.
